user.title: Connect OpenTodo
user.description: Enter your OpenTodo server's address and an API token. Create the token in OpenTodo under Settings → Integrations → API tokens: choose **New token**, give it a name such as "Home Assistant" and the access **Full access**. A **Read only** token also works: you then get the counts and the calendar, but the lists cannot be changed and changes are not pushed. [How it works]({docs_url})

data_description.url: The address you open OpenTodo at, for example {url_example}.
data_description.token: Starts with ot_. It is shown once, when you create it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {title}
reauth_confirm.description: OpenTodo at {url} no longer accepts the token. Create a new one under Settings → Integrations → API tokens (access **Full access**) and paste it here.

data_description.token: Starts with ot_. It must belong to the same account.

reconfigure.title: Change the OpenTodo connection
reconfigure.description: Change the server address or the token. They must still lead to the same account.

data_description.url: The address you open OpenTodo at.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and that OpenTodo is running.
error.not_opentodo: Something answers at this address, but it is not an OpenTodo server.
error.invalid_auth: OpenTodo does not accept this token. Check that you copied all of it and that it was not revoked.
error.agent_token: This is an AI assistant (agent) token. It can only make a few kinds of changes and records them as an assistant's. Create a token with the access Full access (or Read only) instead.
error.admin_token: This is an Admin token. Home Assistant does not need that much access; create a token with the access Full access instead.
error.encrypted_account: This account uses end-to-end encryption. The server cannot read task titles, so Home Assistant cannot show them. Use an account without encryption.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This OpenTodo account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to another OpenTodo account. Use a token of the account set up here.

init.title: OpenTodo options
init.description: Choose the lists Home Assistant shows and how changes arrive. [More about each option]({docs_url})

data.quick_add: Read quick-add syntax in new items

data_description.all_projects: Each project gets a to-do list and a count, new projects included. Turn off to pick projects below.
data_description.projects: Used when "Show every project" is off.
data_description.today_list: A list with what the app shows in Today: due today or earlier, a deadline reached, or a start date come.
data_description.quick_add: "milk tomorrow #Home p1" becomes the task "milk", due tomorrow, in Home, priority 1.
data_description.scan_interval: While instant updates work, Home Assistant still checks every 15 minutes at least.
data_description.push: OpenTodo calls Home Assistant when something changes (a webhook). Needs a token with Full access.
data_description.ha_url: Only if OpenTodo cannot reach Home Assistant at its usual address, for example {ha_url_example}.

push_private_network.title: OpenTodo cannot call Home Assistant on your network

push_failed.title: Instant updates from OpenTodo are off

encrypted_account.title: The OpenTodo account uses end-to-end encryption
encrypted_account.description: {title} stopped updating: the account now uses end-to-end encryption, so the server cannot read task titles and Home Assistant cannot show them. Remove the integration, or turn encryption off for the account in OpenTodo and reload it.

read_only.message: This OpenTodo token is read only. Set up the integration with a token that has Full access to make changes.

auth_failed.message: OpenTodo no longer accepts the token. Enter a new one where Home Assistant asks for it.

task_not_found.message: This task is no longer in OpenTodo.

entry_not_found.message: No OpenTodo account is set up and loaded.

entry_required.message: More than one OpenTodo account is set up: choose one.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task to OpenTodo. The text may use quick-add syntax, such as "milk tomorrow #Home p1 @errands". Returns the new task.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The OpenTodo account, when more than one is set up.

text.name: Text
text.description: The task's title, with quick-add syntax if you like.

project.name: Project
project.description: A project's name or id. Wins over a #project in the text. Without one and without a #project, the task goes to the Inbox.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: The day to do it. Wins over a date in the text.

due_datetime.name: Due date and time
due_datetime.description: The day and time to do it. Wins over a date in the text.

labels.name: Labels
labels.description: Label names, added to those in the text. Missing labels are created.

quick_add.name: Read quick-add syntax
quick_add.description: Turn off to keep the text exactly as the title.
